"""End-to-end sizing: many leases, targets, records, queries, requests."""
import base64, gc, io, json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
import ipaddress, zstandard as zstd
from common import COLUMNS
from gen_targets import plan as plan_targets

def build(nleases=64, subnets=16, low=32, nrecords=200000, nreq=2000, noff=2000, queries=(5, 50, 500, 999),
          encoding='csv', seed=7):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    leases = [{'id': 'L%04d' % i, 'prefix': '2001:db8:%x::/56' % i, 'start': 0, 'end': 1000,
               'subnets': list(range(subnets)), 'low_count': low} for i in range(nleases)]
    services = [{'id': 'tcp%d' % i, 'kind': k} for i, k in enumerate(['tcp', 'adb', 'sync'] * 3)]
    ctx = {l['id']: {**l, 'network': ipaddress.IPv6Network(l['prefix']), 'subnets': l['subnets']} for l in leases}
    manifest, lookup, lows = plan_targets(ctx, 'demo')
    probes = list(lookup)
    header = ','.join(COLUMNS) + '\n'
    buf = io.StringIO()
    buf.write(header)
    for i in range(nrecords):
        lease, probe = probes[rnd.randrange(len(probes))]
        target, canary = lookup[(lease, probe)]
        t = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(target))
        kind = rnd.random()
        pub = rnd.randrange(1000)
        ev = rnd.randrange(0, min(pub, 999) + 1)
        if kind < 0.5:
            result = rnd.choice(['echo', 'echo', 'echo', 'error', 'timeout'])
            if result == 'timeout':
                resp = ''
            elif rnd.random() < 0.7:
                resp = t
            else:
                resp = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address((0x2001 << 112) | (0xdb8 << 96) | rnd.getrandbits(96)))
            buf.write('icmp,r%06d,%d,%d,put,%s,%d,%s,%s,%s,%s,,,\n' % (i, rnd.randrange(3), pub, lease, ev, probe, t, resp, result))
        else:
            svc = services[rnd.randrange(len(services))]['id']
            result = rnd.choice(['open', 'closed', 'timeout'])
            payload = ''
            if result == 'open' and not svc.startswith('tcp'):
                payload = base64.b64encode(bytes(rnd.randrange(256) for _ in range(rnd.randrange(1, 40)))).decode()
            addr = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(rnd.choice(list(lows.values()))[0] if rnd.random() < 0.8
                                             else (0x2001 << 112) | (0xdb8 << 96) | rnd.getrandbits(96)))
            buf.write('app,a%06d,%d,%d,put,%s,%d,,%s,,%s,%s,%d,%s\n' % (i, rnd.randrange(3), pub, lease, ev, addr, result, svc, rnd.randrange(4), payload))
    data = buf.getvalue().encode()
    if encoding == 'zstd':
        data = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3).compress(data)
    chunks = [base64.b64encode(data).decode()]
    captures = [{'encoding': encoding, 'chunks': chunks}]
    reqs = []
    for i in range(nreq):
        lease = leases[rnd.randrange(nleases)]
        subnet = rnd.randrange(subnets)
        iid = rnd.randint(1, low)
        addr = (0x2001 << 112) | (0xdb8 << 96) | (int(lease['prefix'].split(':')[2], 16) << 80) | (subnet << 64) | iid
        reqs.append({'id': 'q%05d' % i, 'at': rnd.choice(queries), 'lease': lease['id'],
                     'target': str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(addr)),
                     'service': services[rnd.randrange(len(services))]['id'],
                     'group': 'g%d' % rnd.randrange(16)})
    offs = []
    for i in range(noff):
        offs.append({'id': 'o%05d' % i, 'time': rnd.randrange(1000), 'service': services[rnd.randrange(len(services))]['id'],
                     'prefix': rnd.choice(['2001:db8::/32', '2001:db8:%x::/56' % rnd.randrange(nleases)]),
                     'capacity': rnd.choice([0, 1, 2, 5, 100]), 'cost': rnd.randrange(1000),
                     'group': 'h%d' % rnd.randrange(16),
                     'requests': ['q%05d' % rnd.randrange(nreq) for _ in range(min(64, nreq))]})
    rq = [{'id': 'g%d' % i, 'parent': None if i == 0 else 'g%d' % (i // 3), 'capacity': rnd.choice([0, 5, 50, 4096])} for i in range(16)]
    oq = [{'id': 'h%d' % i, 'parent': None if i == 0 else 'h%d' % (i // 3), 'capacity': rnd.choice([0, 5, 50, 4096])} for i in range(16)]
    return {'version': 3, 'seed': 'demo', 'leases': leases, 'services': services, 'queries': list(queries),
            'captures': captures, 'requests': reqs, 'offers': offs, 'request_quotas': rq, 'offer_quotas': oq}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import campaign
    kw = json.loads(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else {}
    t = time.time(); job = build(**kw); build_t = time.time() - t
    raw = json.dumps(job).encode()
    print('input bytes %.1f MiB (build %.1fs)' % (len(raw) / 1048576, build_t))
    gc.disable()
    t = time.time(); res = campaign.audit(campaign.parse_json(raw)); dt = time.time() - t
    out = json.dumps(res, separators=(',', ':'))
    print('audit %.1fs, output %.1f MiB, rejected %d, resolved %d' % (dt, len(out) / 1048576,
          len(res['rejected']), res['plan']['resolved']))
    import resource
    print('maxrss %.0f MiB' % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss / 1024))
PYEOF
